{"ticket": "So, I was sitting here trying to set up the new sprint board for our Q3 planning session, which is super critical because the stakeholders are breathing down my neck and I’ve already missed two deadlines due to last year's chaos where the server was literally on fire and we lost three weeks of data, but anyway, the point is I open up Northbeam this morning expecting to drag and drop those user stories into the ready column, but nothing loads, I mean completely blank, just a spinning circle that’s been spinning for twenty minutes now, I’ve tried refreshing, I’ve tried clearing my cache, I’ve tried logging out and back in, I’ve even restarted my router because I thought maybe my WiFi was being weird like it was during that storm last week, but no, literally every single person on my team of twelve is reporting the exact same thing right now, we’re all stuck on the login page or getting 500 errors when we try to hit the API, and it’s not just me, it’s literally everyone in the company, we can’t access any of our projects, we can’t update statuses, we can’t even see the dashboard, it’s a total blackout for the entire organization, which is really frustrating because I have a demo scheduled in an hour and I look like an idiot if I tell the prospect we can’t show them the product, plus our project manager is freaking out because the Gantt chart is offline and we have a hard launch on Friday, so yeah, basically the whole service is down for us and we need this fixed immediately because we are completely paralyzed until it comes back up.", "category": "outage", "priority": "P1", "rationale": "The ticket describes the Northbeam service as unreachable for the customer's whole team, which fits the definition of 'outage' and is automatically assigned P1 priority according to the policy."}

{"ticket": "Hey there, I hope you're having a wonderful week, I just wanted to reach out because something really weird is happening with my Northbeam account and I'm a bit confused, so please bear with me because I've been trying to figure this out for about an hour now while my cat walks across my keyboard and knocks over my coffee, which is a whole other story involving a vintage mug I got in Portland back in 2019, anyway, I logged in this morning to update some project statuses for my design clients and noticed that the dashboard looks slightly different than usual, not like it's broken or anything, just maybe a theme update? But then I went to check my user settings to make sure my profile picture was correct and I saw that my password had been changed recently, and when I tried to change it back it sent a verification email to an address I don't recognize, and if I look at the login history it says I logged in from an IP address in a city I've never visited and my two-factor authentication device list has a new device registered that I definitely didn't add, so I feel like someone might have gotten into my account, which is super stressful because I have sensitive client files in there and I haven't been able to update my invoices yet, but I'm not sure if this is a bug or if I just forgot my own password somewhere, maybe I typed it wrong initially and the system locked me out? It's just very strange and I really need help figuring out if my account is compromised because I can't access the main features properly anymore.", "category": "account_access", "priority": "P1", "rationale": "The ticket describes signs of unauthorized access (unknown IP, changed password, unfamiliar 2FA device), which constitutes a suspected security incident or breach that outranks all other categories and defaults to P1 priority."}

{"ticket": "Hi there, I hope you're having a wonderful Tuesday, though honestly mine has been a bit of a rollercoaster starting with the coffee machine in the breakroom spilling grounds all over the carpet and my intern tripping over the power cord which was already frayed from when the construction crew was in the hallway last week, but anyway I’m writing because I can’t seem to get into the Northbeam app and it’s becoming a real headache because I know we have that big quarterly review coming up next Friday and I really need to pull the Gantt charts but every time I try to log in it just keeps asking for a verification code that I’m not receiving on my phone even though I changed my number last month after my old provider dropped the service in our area and I tried resetting the password three times but it just sends me back to the login screen in this weird loop where the button grays out if I wait more than ten seconds, is there a way to bypass this or can you send a new code to my email? My colleague Sarah says she can get in fine on her laptop so it’s definitely just my device or account somehow, I’ve tried clearing my cache and using incognito mode and even logging in on my personal hotspot just in case the office Wi-Fi is blocking something but nothing works, and since this happened right after I tried to update my 2FA settings following the instructions on your help page which seemed a bit confusing with the QR code not scanning properly on my older iPhone, I was wondering how long a fix will take because I’m worried we’re going to miss the client deadline if I can’t access the project timeline.", "category": "account_access", "priority": "P2", "rationale": "The ticket describes a single user being blocked from logging in due to 2FA issues, which falls under account_access and defaults to P2 for a fully blocked single user."}
